caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a historical garment, specifically a dress from the 18th century. The dress is rendered in light beige or cream tones as the primary color, adorned with a pattern of small floral motifs in green, red, and orange hues scattered across the fabric. The bodice is fitted and decorated with vertical ribbons or bows at the front and has elaborate white trim along the seams, cuffs, and edges. The sleeves are elbow-length, ending in multiple layers of ruffled lace cuffs. The skirt section is very wide and bell-shaped, extending outwards from the hips, and features an open front revealing an underskirt with horizontal white stripes and additional lace decoration. The background of the drawing is plain and neutral, focusing attention solely on the dress, and the figure displaying the dress is headless, with no visible hands or feet.
title: Dress
